results.content: # Bridging corporate purpose and strategic renewal: A review and future research agenda. There is growing interest in the strategic role of corporate purpose in processes of strategic renewal, but existing research appears fragmented and offers mixed insights. To address this issue, this study develops a systematic literature review to identify the links between corporate purpose and strategic renewal across diverse research streams. The proposed research agenda is organized around three main objectives: *testing and elaborating, contextualizing,* and *theorizing* the relationship between corporate purpose and strategic renewal. Her research focuses on understanding the relationship between corporate purpose and strategic renewal across levels of analysis, adopting mainly qualitative methods. His research appeared in journals such as Journal of Management Studies, Strategy Science, and Family Business Review. **Josip Kotlar** (email: ) is Full Professor of Strategy, Innovation, and Family Business at the School of Management of Politecnico di Milano (Italy).

results.content: # Strategic HR in 2026: A Practical HR Strategic Plan to Build Thriving Teams. HR is uniquely positioned to influence the KPIs executives care about most—alignment, performance, retention, manager effectiveness, and culture strength—but only when strategy connects insight to action and equips managers to lead well. A strategic HR partner isn’t just an HR professional who “thinks big.” It’s a leader who bridges strategy and execution—connecting the realities of teams with the direction of the business. Works closely with HR departments and the leadership team to align talent strategies with broader organizational goals, fostering a unified and purpose-driven workforce. A strategic HR plan is a focused roadmap that connects people strategy to business strategy and gives managers the clarity and tools they need to execute consistently. Start by deeply understanding organizational priorities, then translate them into role clarity, aligned goals, and simple frameworks managers can use with their teams. HR can support managers with simple frameworks, decision-ready insights, and lightweight tools that make alignment, coaching, and recognition easier.
